claim: MSGD is an externally curated Multiple Sclerosis Gene Database cataloging MS-related gene knowledge across variants, RNA, protein, knockout, drug-target, and high-throughput entry types.
future_grounding_route: Specific MSGD gene or drug entries can be queued as external-verifiable hypotheses and tested against project-held genetics, expression, perturbation, or treatment-response data before they are used as project evidence.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging; helps public readers distinguish this repository from a dedicated MS gene-knowledge database.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Manually curated MS gene-entry database spanning literature-mined variants, RNA, protein, knockout, drug-target, and high-throughput records.
why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun MSGD's manual literature extraction and curation pipeline from this repository.
